news.headline:
The Children's Place, a customer of Gokaldas Exports' subsidiary Atraco, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the US.

Atraco has outstanding receivables of USD 4.2 Mn, and Gokaldas Exports is assessing the potential business impact.

Source: BSE

The company also anticipates high single-digit growth for FY27.

news.headline:
Datamatics reported Q2 revenue of INR 546.6 crores, up 11.5% YoY, with PAT rising 16.1% to INR 73.4 crores.

EBITDA jumped 30% to INR 115.5 crores with a 21.1% margin, driven by strong growth in Digital Operations.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
V-Mart's South India business delivered higher EBITDA, while LimeRoad's top line rose 55% with losses narrowing to 8%.

Food inflation, competition, and festive shifts impacted growth, even as 58% of online orders shipped from 613 stores.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
Matrimony.com Q2 net profit rose to ₹21 crore from ₹8 crore, with revenue increasing 17.6% YoY to ₹134.8 crore.

EBITDA reached ₹30.2 crore compared to ₹12.1 crore YoY, with EBITDA margin expanding to 22.4% from 10.5%.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
Ekennis Software Service will hold a board meeting on November 14, 2026, to approve half-yearly unaudited financial results.

The trading window for designated persons remains closed from October 1, 2026, until 48 hours post result declaration.

Source: BSE
